The <b>{{lc:{{PAGENAME}}}}</b> is a food item which restores {{Energy|+|13}} and applies the 'steady hand' buff when consumed. For more information on preparing food see [[cooking]].

==Effect==

On use, a {{lc:{{PAGENAME}}}} will apply the steady hand buff for a duration of 2 minutes, reducing the risk of surgical errors during body part extraction. For a list of all buffs see the [[Effects]] page.
